items.question: What services does HULEGEB currently provide?
items.answer: HULEGEB currently provides veterinary services, artificial insemination services, and livestock consultation services.

items.question: Does HULEGEB provide veterinary services?
items.answer: Yes. Veterinary services are one of HULEGEB’s current service areas and are focused on supporting livestock health and animal care.

items.question: Does HULEGEB provide artificial insemination services?
items.answer: Yes. Artificial insemination is one of HULEGEB’s current services and supports improved breeding management for livestock owners.

items.question: What kind of livestock consultation does HULEGEB provide?
items.answer: HULEGEB provides livestock consultation to support better health, breeding, and management decisions for farmers and livestock owners.

items.question: Who can use HULEGEB services?
items.answer: HULEGEB services are intended for livestock owners, farmers, and people seeking professional support for animal health, breeding, and livestock management.

items.question: Where does HULEGEB currently provide services?
items.answer: HULEGEB’s current services are delivered through its operational service areas and local livestock service activities.

items.question: Is HULEGEB already offering a digital livestock platform?
items.answer: Not as a current service offering. HULEGEB’s broader digital livestock platform concept represents future development and innovation, while current operations remain focused on veterinary, AI, and consultation services.

items.question: What is the future vision of HULEGEB?
items.answer: HULEGEB’s future vision includes exploring digital livestock services, technology-enabled coordination, and data-driven solutions that can strengthen livestock support over time.

who.title: About Hulegeb
who.paragraphShort: Hulegeb is a livestock service initiative designed to help farmers maximize their productivity and profits. We provide hands-on professional veterinary care to treat and prevent animal diseases.
who.moreParagraph: Our advanced artificial insemination services introduce high-quality genetics to improve breed traits like milk and meat yield. Additionally, our expert livestock consultation helps farmers make smart, data-driven decisions about daily farm management, animal nutrition, and long-term business growth. By putting farmers first, Hulegeb ensures healthier herds, better breeding outcomes, and sustainable farming success.
who.overlayText: Our work centers on helping farmers access dependable support for livestock health, breeding, and management in a practical and locally responsive way.

mission.title: Mission & Vision
mission.missionText: Hulegeb Agricultural Supports Service PLC is committed to providing accessible, reliable and professional veterinary and artificial insemination (AI) services to livestock owners, surrounding villages and commercial livestock farms. The company aims to improve livestock productivity, reproductive performance and farm profitability through timely animal health services, quality breeding services, professional technical support and contractual livestock management services.
mission.visionText: To become a leading and trusted livestock veterinary and artificial insemination service provider in Ethiopia, contributing to productive, healthy and profitable livestock farming.

strategy.title: A practical model for lasting livestock impact
strategy.overallGoal: To improve livestock production and productivity in surrounding communities and commercial livestock farms by delivering quality veterinary, animal health and artificial insemination services on a sustainable and commercially viable basis.
specificGoals: Provide accessible veterinary services through the licensed livestock clinic or station to livestock owners in surrounding villages.
Deliver professional artificial insemination services to improve genetic quality, reproductive performance and livestock productivity.
Reduce livestock diseases and mortality through preventive, diagnostic, treatment and animal health advisory services.
Provide contractual livestock services to commercial farms, including regular veterinary care, herd health monitoring, reproductive management, AI services and technical advisory support.
Improve livestock farm productivity and profitability with integrated animal health, breeding and management services tailored to each farm.
Establish long-term service contracts with livestock farms for reliable and continuous veterinary and reproductive-health support.
Serve surrounding rural communities with veterinary and AI services that are more accessible, timely and affordable.
Promote improved livestock breeding practices through farmer education, reproductive monitoring and appropriate use of improved genetics.
Develop a sustainable agricultural service business that creates employment and contributes to the local livestock sector.
strategy.brandGoal: Build Hulegeb as a trusted livestock service brand recognized for professionalism, responsiveness, animal welfare, quality service and practical results.
strategy.modelText: We combine affordable veterinary and AI services for surrounding livestock owners with contract-based professional livestock services for commercial and institutional farms. This serves smallholder farmers while creating a stable business revenue stream.
strategy.longTermText: Develop from a livestock clinic and AI service provider into an integrated livestock service company offering animal health, reproductive, breeding, herd-management and farm advisory services.
